subject: KaleidoAnalytics renewal — premium SLA & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Liam O'Donnell <liam.odonnell@kaleidoanalytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0000
Subject: Renewal proposal and capacity forecast

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

Hope you’re both well. We’re approaching our annual renewal on 2026-08-01 and wanted to surface a couple of asks from the platform team that will determine whether we take the expansion path this cycle: 

- We need a Premium SLA option that guarantees p95 latency <= 250ms for our production text-generation routes (at current traffic profile).
- A capacity uplift of ~2.5x reserved throughput for the next 12 months, with an option to add burst credits for peak events.
- A clear escalation path and 24/7 priority support (pager/on-call) for incidents impacting production latency.

I've attached our Q2 usage report so you can see the burst windows and token distribution. Procurement will also need a price ladder and standard SLA amendment to run through legal.

Tentatively we’re prepared to sign a 12-month committed contract if the SLA and capacity can be contracted with predictable pricing. Can you share a proposed SLA draft and pricing range by next Wednesday (2026-06-30)? Procurement contact is procurement@kaleidoanalytics.com — cc'd on this thread.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Donnell
Head of Platform
KaleidoAnalytics
liam.odonnell@kaleidoanalytics.com

Attachment: usage_report_Q2_2026.csv (CSV, 72KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Donnell <liam.odonnell@kaleidoanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@kaleidoanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and capacity forecast

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and for sharing the Q2 report. We've reviewed the burst behavior and have a recommended path that balances latency guarantees with predictable unit economics: 

1) Contract shape: 12-month committed term with stepped SLA tiers. For Kaleido's profile we can offer a Premium SLA guaranteeing p95 <= 250ms on the marked production routes, paired with a reserved capacity commitment (2.5x current baseline) and a monthly pool of burst credits.

2) Support: Priority support (SLA owners + designated on-call escalation) with a 15-minute acknowledgement for Sev1 incidents and a documented escalation matrix. We will add a named escalation manager and include quarterly runbook reviews.

3) Pricing & credits: We’ll propose a blended uplift for reserved capacity + a small monthly fee for the premium SLA. I’ll loop in pricing details separately, but from a commercial standpoint we should plan for a ~22–28% uplift over current committed spend depending on the final capacity band.

Attached is a draft SLA amendment (SLA_Amendment_Kaleido_v1.pdf) and our onboarding/runbook package (redwood_onboarding_runbook.docx). Please confirm whether procurement requires any specific language around data retention or audit logs — happy to accommodate.

Next steps: 
- You confirm procurement timeline (PO + signature owner)
- We finalize pricing (Ben to send proposal)
- We publish a DocuSign-ready amendment and schedule kickoff

If that works, I propose a short kickoff with your platform + ours on Mon 2026-07-05 to align runbooks and monitoring.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai

Attachments: SLA_Amendment_Kaleido_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB); redwood_onboarding_runbook.docx (DOCX, 120KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 17:02:00 -0000
Subject: Internal: Kaleido pricing bands and credit ask

Quick internal note — I reviewed usage and Sofia's SLA draft. High level: we can meet the 250ms p95 but it consumes more guaranteed capacity on the GPU pools. Pricing thinking: 

- Option A (conservative): 12m term, 2.5x reserved, 22% uplift, 1 month burst credits included.
- Option B (value): 24m term, 2.5x reserved, 18% uplift, additional 2 months burst credits, deeper discount if they commit to a 24m contract.

We should also include a one-time onboarding credit (10% of monthly committed value) to cover runbook/monitoring work. Approve to present Option A as the standard and mention Option B as a negotiation lever? Need quick sign-off from Marissa because this impacts margin carveout.

Ben
Head of Renewals
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Donnell <liam.odonnell@kaleidoanalytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@kaleidoanalytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@kaleidoanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 14:19:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and capacity forecast

Thanks Sofia — this is helpful. Procurement timeline: PO ready the week of 2026-07-12, with a target signature by 2026-07-20. Procurement will circulate the PO once we have the DocuSign-ready amendment and the final pricing band.

We’re aligned in principle with Option A; procurement may push for the 24m Option B but they need the final unit economics to review. Key asks from our side before legal signs off: 
- Include explicit latency measurement routes (we’ll share route names)
- Add SLA exclusion language for force majeure and planned maintenance windows (we can tolerate a short scheduled maintenance with prior notice)
- Define a rollback/fallback in the event of repeated SLA breaches (temporary traffic steering to a compatible variant)

I’ll have procurement@kaleidoanalytics.com send the PO owner details and attach our standard PO terms. We can commit to the kickoff meeting the week after signature.

Onwards — Liam

On Thu, Jun 25, 2026 at 16:12 Liam O'Donnell <liam.odonnell@kaleidoanalytics.com> wrote:
> Hi Sofia / Marissa,
> 
> Hope you’re both well. We’re approaching our annual renewal on 2026-08-01 and wanted to surface a couple of asks from the platform team that will determine whether we take the expansion path this cycle: ...

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Donnell <liam.odonnell@kaleidoanalytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@kaleidoanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and capacity forecast — next steps and docs

Liam / Procurement — thanks for the timeline. Per our internal alignment we’ll: 

1) Publish a DocuSign-ready SLA amendment (attached link) and a pricing summary for Option A and Option B by EOD 2026-07-02.
2) Include explicit route names and measurement windows — please send the route names by 2026-07-02 so we can bake them into the amendment.
3) Add the requested maintenance & force majeure language and a temporary fallback clause that allows traffic steering to a compatible variant during remediation.

Links: 
- HubSpot opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/558 (internal)
- DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/example-ds-kaleido-558

Proposed kickoff: Wed 2026-07-21 16:00 UTC (post-signature) — 30 minutes to align runbook ownership and monitoring alerts. Marissa / Ben / Logan will attend from our side.

Once procurement confirms PO owner we’ll send the DocuSign envelope. Looking forward to getting Kaleido onboarded to the premium SLA.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
